biggest_catch: The $25 lands only if your friend actually shops and earns $10 of real purchase cashback within a year — send a link to someone who never buys anything and you get nothing.
catches: Your friend must be a brand-new BeFrugal member joining through your referral link — existing members do not count.
Your friend must earn $10 of purchase-derived cashback (bonuses and non-purchase activity excluded) within 365 days of joining.
Your $25 bonus is per referred friend; the page states you can repeat as often as desired.
Timing of the $25 credit is not publicly specified on the program page.

c1.evidence: BeFrugal — real cashback portal; program details on official befrugal.com blog/help page.

c2.evidence: Official BeFrugal page 'Earn Cash Bonuses with the BeFrugal Refer-a-Friend Program' states the $25 referrer reward and the $10 friend reward with qualification rules.

c3.evidence: No fee to participate; free to join BeFrugal.

c4.evidence: Official page confirms $25 per referred friend once the friend earns $10 of qualifying cashback; friend gets $10.

eligibility: Referred friend must be a new BeFrugal member joining via your referral link and must earn $10 of purchase-derived cashback within 365 days. Bonuses and non-purchase earnings do not count. Existing members excluded.
notes: Official terms reviewed 2026-09-23. Payout timing for the $25 referrer bonus is not publicly stated on the page, so it is marked as unspecified rather than guessed. No cap stated on number of referrals ('repeat as often as desired'). Generic BeFrugal cashback (R0131) is a separate route; this referral method is distinct.
payout_quote: The official BeFrugal page states you get a $25 bonus for each friend who joins through your referral link and earns $10 of purchase cashback; your friend gets $10 once they earn that $10.

s1.note: New members only via referral link; $10 must be purchase-derived cashback earned within 365 days; existing members excluded.

s2.note: Reward paid in cashback balance (withdrawable like normal BeFrugal earnings); no hidden fees disclosed for participation.

s3.note: Timing of the $25 referrer credit is not publicly specified on the program page.

s4.note: No weasel words on the amounts — $25 and $10 stated flatly.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: share link, friend joins and shops enough to earn $10 purchase cashback within a year, both get paid.

steps: Sign up for a free BeFrugal account.
Find your referral link on the refer-a-friend page and share it with a friend.
Your friend must be a new BeFrugal member and join through your link.
Your friend shops through BeFrugal until they have earned $10 of cashback from purchases (bonuses and non-purchase activity do not count), within 365 days.
Once that happens, your friend gets a $10 bonus and you get a $25 bonus.
Withdraw via your normal BeFrugal payout method when available.
timing: Not publicly specified on the program page.
